title: Meet the 26 Superstars Kicking Off America's World Cup Dreams!
summary: Imagine standing in a stadium with 70,000 fans screaming your name. For 26 American soccer players, that dream becomes real on Friday! The U.S. Men's National Team kicks off the 2026 World Cup against Paraguay in Los Angeles. This is the biggest soccer party on Earth, and these guys have trained their whole lives for it. Let's meet some stars! Christian Pulisic is the team's top scorer with 33 goals. He plays for AC Milan in Italy and finally broke a scoring slump last month. Then there's Folarin Balogun, a striker born in Brooklyn who chose to play for the U.S. He scored 19 goals for his club team this season—that's almost one every other game! Ricardo Pepi was heartbroken when he missed the last World Cup, but now he's back with 19 goals of his own. Coach says his time is now. Tim Weah's dad won soccer's biggest prize, but Tim is making his own name. He scored in the last World Cup. Brenden Aaronson got married just two weeks ago and is ready to spark the team off the bench. With players from all over the world, this team is a mix of speed, skill, and big dreams. Will they make America proud? Tune in and find out!
why_it_matters: Soccer teaches teamwork and dreaming big—just like these players, you can work hard to achieve your goals, whether in sports or at school.

background_read: The FIFA World Cup is the biggest soccer tournament in the world, held every four years. In 2026, the United States, Canada, and Mexico will host the tournament together for the first time.
AC Milan is a famous professional soccer team based in Milan, Italy, that has won many trophies.
The U.S. Men's National Team has participated in several World Cups, but has never won the title.
Article_Structure: WHO: 26 American soccer players, including stars like Christian Pulisic, Folarin Balogun, and Ricardo Pepi.
WHAT: They are kicking off the 2026 World Cup with their first game against Paraguay.
WHERE: In Los Angeles, at a stadium with 70,000 fans.
WHY: To represent the United States in the world's biggest soccer tournament and make the country proud.

perspectives.description: The players see this as a once-in-a-lifetime chance to shine in front of a home crowd.
Some fans worry that the team might feel too much pressure to win, especially with high expectations.
Coaches and team leaders believe the mix of young and experienced players will bring the perfect balance.
